title: 29709 - 29709/U1013/053267
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
technicalNotes: In certain cases this code may be stored even after properly coding a module (e.g. VW RNS510 or 9W7). In such cases make sure to use a proper workshop code (WSC), importer and device number. Entering defaults such as 12345/123/12345 in the boxes beneath the New coding followed by recoding the module to the same value should resolve those issues:
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
